items.summary: 中新网绍兴11月28日电 “越享嵊州·剧绽四海”第四届“越嵊州 越有戏”乡村越剧联赛(嵊州村越)闭幕式晚会27日在嵊州市体育中心举行。
items.content:
中新网绍兴11月28日电 “越享嵊州·剧绽四海”第四届“越嵊州 越有戏”乡村越剧联赛(嵊州村越)闭幕式晚会27日在嵊州市体育中心举行。

1906年，嵊州甘霖镇东王村一方稻桶搭成戏台，第一声吟唱从田间地头响起。120年风雨流转，越剧从乡野小调成长为全国第二大剧种。这场村越闭幕晚会，恰好站在百廿时间节点上，回望来路，也望向远方。

第一篇章《回望来路》登场，越剧《女班》一亮相，现场瞬间沸腾。演员们走上舞台，用练功、对戏的日常片段，还原百年前女子科班学艺的模样。没有繁复的布景，仅凭身段、神态，就勾勒出老一辈越剧人咬牙坚持的模样。台下新老戏迷轻轻跟着哼起早期“呤嗄调”，越剧的传承，就藏在这一老一少的共鸣里。

《百廿星光》篇章接续登场，流派联唱轮番上演。浙江音乐学院越剧学院师生、浙江小百花越剧院、上海越剧院、绍兴市越剧团的演员和村越选手同台献艺，婉转唱腔落下，全场掌声久久不息。

《越风国潮》篇章则以创新方式推动东方戏韵与现代表达相融。阿卡贝拉重新演绎《五女拜寿》《血手印》，纯人声编曲打破传统唱腔的框架，熟悉的旋律焕发出全新质感。来自美国、阿尔及利亚、喀麦隆、巴西、乌兹别克斯坦等国的留学生，用普通话演唱《红楼梦》《梁祝》选段，引得台下阵阵欢笑，欢笑过后是热烈持久的掌声。

随后，戏曲绝活登场，长水袖、打出手、喷火轮番上演，不同剧种在同一方舞台交融碰撞。

《戏韵众生》篇章将舞台交还给草根戏迷，新苗组、新秀组、名票组选手轮番登台，稚嫩却坚定的唱腔展现了越剧薪火相传的力量。梅花奖得主、民营剧团演员同台和鸣，名家搭台、草根唱戏，勾勒出越剧扎根民间最动人的图景。

压轴篇章《越向未来》将整场晚会推向最高潮。王君安、何赛飞、吴凤花等越剧名家倾情表演，晚会在村越主题曲《传越》中落幕。

据了解，自2023年起，嵊州创办乡村越剧联赛，前三届举办近300场比赛，近5000名选手登台竞演。本届村越首次面向全球开放报名，开设民营剧团竞鸣赛、越剧戏迷竞放赛、海外越迷竞扬赛三条赛道，吸引39个本土剧团、1800余名海内外越剧爱好者参与。(完)

items.summary: 中新网西安11月28日电 (记者 阿琳娜)2026年度新疆维吾尔自治区文艺扶持激励资金项目——原创音乐剧《北庭·望长安》27日、28日在西安上演。该剧以北庭故城为历史依托，以唐代北庭军民孤守三十五载的正史记载为创作蓝本。
items.content:
中新网西安11月28日电 (记者 阿琳娜)2026年度新疆维吾尔自治区文艺扶持激励资金项目——原创音乐剧《北庭·望长安》27日、28日在西安上演。该剧以北庭故城为历史依托，以唐代北庭军民孤守三十五载的正史记载为创作蓝本。

北庭故城是唐代北庭都护府治所。该剧以安史之乱为叙事转折点，以序幕《纷飞》、第一幕《辞阙·长歌》、第二幕《兴壤·合礼》、第三幕《裂帛·惊弦》、尾声《千树万树梨花开》的递进式结构铺展叙事，将个体离愁与家国大义交织相融。

故事讲述将领郭勣率部远赴北庭，与当地各族百姓筑城屯垦、通商兴学，共建边塞家园；第二幕《兴壤·合礼》以民俗相融的礼乐、互助共生的日常，细致还原各族人民守望相助、交融共生的温情图景；战乱爆发后北庭精锐奉诏入关勤王，孤城自此援绝粮尽，各族军民仍同心坚守三十五年，以铸钱、种粮、守城、送信等行动，诠释心向家国、守护疆土的信念。

剧中筑城、屯田等情节源自唐代治理边疆的真实制度，各族群像展现了各民族共同建设边疆、捍卫国土的历史图景。

剧作以琴弦、红纱两大信物为脉络，搭建起双线并行、虚实相生的情感体系：琴弦承载文人将士对长安文脉的初心坚守，红纱寄托边疆烟火、故土思念与人情牵挂，让抽象的家国情怀与故土相思变得可触可感。

据介绍，在舞台呈现上，剧目把丝绸之路传统美学理念与当代舞台科技融为一体，营造出兼具中式古典韵味与现代审美的沉浸式观感。

舞台布景克制而富有底蕴，以漫天风雪、古城遗址、边塞烽墩、戈壁古道为核心视觉符号，依托光影明暗的动态切换，在长安都城的繁华盛景与北庭孤城的清冷萧瑟之间自如转换，形成强烈的视觉反差。

舞蹈编排融合古代传统乐舞范式与现代舞台剧表演技巧，展现北庭民俗乐舞的段落轻盈雅致，承袭唐代丝路乐舞独有的气韵格调；刻画戍边士兵的集体舞蹈则刚健豪迈、节奏铿锵，把将士守护疆土的忠诚与孤勇展现得入木三分。(完)

items.content:
中新网北京11月28日电 (记者 徐婧)“国粹焕彩 京聚西城”2026京剧文化季27日晚收官。活动历时两个多月，30余场精品展演与惠民活动接连登场，剧场、会馆、社区、校园、商圈、影院多点开花，推动京剧艺术走出戏台、走进城市。

本届文化季由中国戏剧家协会、北京市西城区委区政府主办，中共北京市西城区委宣传部、北京市西城区文学艺术界联合会承办。以“传承之脉”“传播之脉”双脉络串联系列活动，以多个开放延展场景构建活态生长的戏曲文化生态。

“传承之脉”坚守国粹艺术本体，深耕经典传承与行业发展。安徽省徽京剧院精品剧目《刘铭传》率先登场，唱响京皖文脉交融的序章；风雷京剧团骨子老戏《一战成功·定军山》、中国戏曲学院优秀新编京剧等剧目轮番登台；“守正创新启新程”研讨会汇聚京津冀及大运河沿线专家院团，共商戏曲发展。

items.content:
第四频道被迫在首播三天前为其休·爱德华兹的纪录片辩护，该电视台的新闻负责人表示这部电影“具有明确的公众利益”。

第四频道上周推出了休·爱德华兹《有罪》，并将于周二晚上播出。它已经遭到包括英国政府高层在内的一系列批评。

新闻主管路易莎·康普顿今天早上罕见地发表了一份冗长的声明，她说：“我们理解有些人会非常不同意我们制作这部电影的决定。但不适本身并不是新闻业不提出困难问题的理由。我们相信这些问题符合公众利益。”

该声明是在总理发言人表示国家“没有兴趣听[爱德华兹]说的话”之后发表的，同时向“儿童性虐待和性剥削的受害者”表示敬意。

Channel 4 has been forced to defend its Huw Edwards doc three days before it premieres, with the network’s news chief saying the film has “clear public interest.”

Channel 4 unveiled Huw Edwards – Guilty last week and it will air Tuesday night. It has already been met with a barrage of criticism including from the upper echelons of UK government.

News chief Louisa Compton issued a rare and lengthy statement this morning, saying: “We understand that some people will profoundly disagree with our decision to make this film. But discomfort is not, in itself, a reason for journalism not to ask difficult questions. We believe those questions are in the public interest.”

The statement came after the Prime Minister’s spokesperson said the country has “no interest in hearing what [Edwards] has to say,” while paying tribute to the “victims of child sexual abuse and exploitation.”

Compton joined with government in saying that behind Edwards’ offences are “real children and real victims – including those as young as seven – who have been abused.”

But she stressed that the disgraced ex-BBC News anchor “is not being allowed to tell his story unchallenged or on his own terms,” and was not paid or given editorial control.

“Journalism isn’t about only putting people on television whose actions or opinions we approve of,” she added. “Sometimes its purpose is precisely the opposite: to look directly at people who have done terrible things, confront them with difficult questions, test their explanations and allow audiences to judge what they say for themselves.”

Compton, who was recently promoted to Director of News, Digital and Audience Trust, said the doc “raises wider and uncomfortable questions about power, trust and accountability, and about how our criminal justice system responds to people convicted of offences involving indecent images of children.”

Airing on Tuesday night, the doc will be the first time Edwards has spoken publicly on TV about his conviction and fall from grace. He has addressed his actions on his Substack but this will be the first time he speaks about them with an interviewer. A short trailer sees Edwards say “I’d lost the plot” after being questioned over why he did what he did. The interviewer can then be heard saying exasperatedly, “Oh, come on.”

Allegations of grooming and paying younger people for sexually explicit images were published about Edwards in 2023 by The Sun and the following year he pled guilty to making indecent images of children. He has since mostly retreated from public life, returning to where he grew up in Wales, which is where the doc takes place.

items.title: 【文化消费】网络文化综艺《非遗之城·守护季》研讨会举行
items.summary: 中新网北京11月28日电 (记者 高凯)由国家广播电视总局网络视听节目管理司指导、中国电视艺术委员会主办的网络文化综艺《非遗之城·守护季》研讨会日前在京举行。
items.content:
中新网北京11月28日电 (记者 高凯)由国家广播电视总局网络视听节目管理司指导、中国电视艺术委员会主办的网络文化综艺《非遗之城·守护季》研讨会日前在京举行。

网络文化综艺《非遗之城·守护季》以“一城双非遗”为框架，通过嘉宾拜师学艺、实地寻访，串联起文物、烟火与传承故事。

会上，《非遗之城·守护季》主创代表，优酷人文纪实总经理、节目总制片人王晓楠表示，在非遗题材已被广泛表现的情况下，节目仍选择这一选题，是希望深究非遗如何走进生活，追问什么样的审美、精神和民族智慧能够穿越时间。这也是节目始终坚持的内核。

节目制片人罗媛表示，本季节目走进六座城市、探访九种非遗。在节目拍摄过程中，创作团队和节目嘉宾的躬身付出，让非遗真正落进了烟火气里。北京邮电大学教授、节目总策划黄悦认为，当下非遗缺少的不是曝光而是被理解，“守护季”要守护的不只是一门手艺原本的样子，而是它古老且新鲜的灵魂。

特邀专家，故宫博物院第六任院长、节目常驻嘉宾单霁翔表示，《非遗之城·守护季》难得之处，是让人们看到非遗从古至今一直是“最时髦”的——它们跟着时代持续进步，从未停滞于某个时段、某个时代。节目不再停留于介绍某地有多少非遗、如何使用，而是把一项项技艺从制作到走进人们生活的过程展现得淋漓尽致。

多位专家表示，该节目从看见非遗走向行动守护，为网络视听讲好中华优秀传统文化故事交出了有启示意义的答卷，也证明了文化类网络综艺不必靠猎奇博眼球，扎根土地、尊重传统就能叫好又叫座。未来，非遗题材作品可以加强比较思考与地域差异化表达，增强思辨性，把守护做成行动，把新生做成可复制的路径。

据悉，本次研讨会得到了中国互联网发展基金会网络视听精品扶持专项基金支持。(完)

在导演让-弗朗索瓦·里歇 (Jean-François Richet) 执导的 Netflix 前传中，文森特·卡塞尔 (Vincent Cassel) 饰演著名维克多·雨果 (Victor Hugo) 角色的超级英雄版本。

当电影业诉诸 19 世纪的 IP 时，这并不一定是经济衰退的指标，但最近维克多·雨果和大仲马的大量改编作品（《基督山伯爵》、《三个火枪手》、《悲惨世界》）肯定也并不表明这个行业绝对有信心。现在，一部新电影加入了这个行列，导演让-弗朗索瓦·里奇和明星文森特·卡塞尔再次联手拍摄了一部包包安全广告片《驼背，巴黎之魂》。

因为这是著名雨果小说事件的前传，该小说催生了无数的改编：作者本人以角色的形式出现（别问），《悲惨世界》中加弗洛什的新版本也是如此。影片开始时，画外音简洁地解释道，在法国国王最近颁布新法律压制公民自由之际，卡西莫多（卡塞尔饰）代表着“人民的人……代表被蔑视者的人”。

但首先我们必须见到这个人，他一开始穿着紧身衣在一家临终关怀医院处理霍乱的爆发，那里的主管医生（本杰明·沃辛，上班打卡）相信驼背掌握着疫苗的关键，因为他奇迹般地抵抗了这种疾病。卡西莫多凭借超人的力量（稍后会详细介绍）逃脱并在大教堂内避难，他的蓝眼睛反映了建筑物的颜色

items.originalContent:
Vincent Cassel stars as a superheroic version of the famous Victor Hugo character in a lavish and unnecessary Netflix prequel from director Jean-François Richet.

It isn’t necessarily a recession indicator when cinema resorts to 19th-century IP, but the raft of recent Victor Hugo and Alexandre Dumas adaptations (“The Count of Monte Cristo,” “The Three Musketeers,” “Les Misérables”) surely doesn’t point to a resolutely confident industry either. Now a new film joins these ranks, as director Jean-François Richet and star Vincent Cassel team up once again for “The Hunchback, Soul of Paris,” a bag-securing adventure set within what we must unfortunately term “the extended Victor Hugoniverse.”

For this acts as a prequel to the events of the famous Hugo novel, which has spawned countless adaptations: The author himself appears as a character (don’t ask), as does a new iteration of Gavroche from “Les Mis.” As the film begins, a voiceover explains sententiously that, at a time when the king of France had recently brought in new laws to crush civil liberties, Quasimodo (Cassel) stands as “a man of the people… a man to represent the scorned and crushed populace.”

But first we must meet the fellow, who at the outset is straitjacketed in a hospice dealing with an outbreak of cholera, where the superintendent doctor (Benjamin Voisin, clocking in for work) believes that the hunchback holds the key to a vaccine, as he is miraculously resistant to the illness. Quasimodo escapes thanks to his superhuman strength (of which more later) and takes refuge within the cathedral, his blue eye reflecting the building’s vast rose window before we surge over the ancient city for a money-flaunting title card. Pa-dam! The stakes are set!

At this stage it’s instructive to remember that both Cassel and Richet originally came to the fore with urgent dramas (“La Haine” and “Ma 6-T Va Crack-er”) set in the cités of Parisian suburbs, which sounded popular unrest among France’s dispossessed, chiefly immigrant communities. “The Hunchback, Soul of Paris” ostensibly sides with the people but its approach is perhaps a little less than strictly Marxist-Leninist, as Richet uses his vast budget to indulge in every period drama trope under the sun.

Adopting a formidable declension of every colour from sepia to brown, Richet depicts light streaming through dusty windows; moaning invalids with sores; plucky street urchins; an olde laboratory; a bawdy sex-worker; grimy cobbled streets galore of course; and last but not least, an opulent dinner party, filmed in flat shot/reverse shot, during which two men debate the ethical implications of scientific advancement over the port course. A sure sign of the film’s ambient bourgeoisie comes in its treatment of Notre-Dame itself, which we first encounter as an exceptionally hallowed place filled with spiritual light from on high as angelic choirs warble impossibly high notes: Here, you see, is the soul of Paris.

But back to the young doctor, who, you see, believes it is advisable to use the less fortunate in order to benefit science, and to this end orders that Quasimodo be brought to him by hook or by crook, enlisting the help of the corrupt police chief Coco-Lacour (played by Karim Leklou with remarkable commitment and finesse, where a much less engaged performance would have sufficed). There ensues — and this is really quite baffling — an almost total lack of plot development for the best part of an hour. Instead, we meet Agnès (Daphné Patakia), a young and gutsy street performer with whom Quasimodo falls in love, prefiguring Esmeralda, and observe the titular hunchback as he defends her, scurries around, and lugs huge blocks of marble about the place.

In one of the film’s big ideas, Quasimodo is depicted as having superhuman strength, which situates this story about scientists wanting to study his powers in the same lineage as “X-Men” and “Captain America.” One suspects that dimension won’t send Gen-Z flocking, and it is a rather tired formula overall, giving a handful of fight scenes a wearisome sense of déjà vu as the guys getting punched skid a good three further meters along the ground than you might expect.

As events very slowly begin to grind towards a climactic confrontation, Cassel seems hampered by the main character’s make-up and lack of characterization, his performance reduced to a mere bodily incarnation of the hunchback. (A late scene in which he stammeringly bonds with Agnès, on a high rampart atop the cathedral, is perfectly risible and symptomatic of a much wider problem with character-building.) Patakia, as the somewhat modern-minded tart with a heart, is appealing and sensitive enough, but the role is paper-thin. At last, the capturing of Quasimodo sparks a skirmish and Paris starts to burn, but even here Richet feels uninspired, and the battle scenes — while handsomely art-directed — lack energy and pizzazz. It’s left to Patakia, in a bonnet and décolleté, to mirror Eugène Delacroix’s “Liberty Leading the People,” in a rather mortifying slow-mo that encapsulates the film’s general vanity and lack of inspiration.

items.originalContent:
BET on Friday announced the creation of the Chaka Khan Humanitarian Award to recognize “musicians and cultural figures who have made outstanding contributions to humanitarianism, community service and social justice.”

The award will be presented annually beginning in 2027 at the Soul Train Awards. The new honor was revealed at Friday’s Soul Train Awards on BET and CBS. The show, back after a three-year hiatus, was taped in Chicago earlier this month and hosted by Anthony Anderson.

Chaka Khan attended the show to receive the Classic Soul Honor, presented by Target.

“My music has given me a voice, but love has given me purpose,” said Khan in a statement about her eponymous honor. “This award isn’t about me; it’s about all of us who believe in lifting others, holding each other up, and building a world where compassion lives. I’m grateful to everyone who walks that path and future generations to carry this forward.”

During the ceremony that was light on awards, fans selected Tyla as the recipient of the R&B/Soul Song of the Year for her hit “Chanel” while PartyNextDoor was the inaugural winner of Spotify’s RNB X International Artist Award.

Elmiene received the New Soul Honor and Durand Bernarr took home the Soul Personified Honor.

The awards ceremony featured performances by Kirk Franklin, Lucky Dave, Muni Long and BET amplified artists Jaydon and Jai’Len Josey. The late Dolly Parton was honored by Mickey Guyton, Brittney Spencer and Robert Randolph, while El Debarge paid tribute to the late Freddie Jackson.

Connie Orlando served as executive producer of the Soul Train Awards. Jesse Collins Entertainment is the production company for the show, with Jesse Collins, Dionne Harmon and Jeannae Rouzan-Clay also serving as executive producers.

items.summary: 除了软件服务，这个黑五还有这些硬件值得一看。 查看全文
items.content:
曾几何时，黑色星期五对于国内的数码爱好者来说也是一个重要的购物节日，一方面恰好衔接了双十一和双十二之间的空档期，另一方面能通过海外的平台购买到一些国内售价较高或者没有官方售卖渠道的商品。然而，随着国补的上线、国产品牌的强势发展、亚马逊电商退出中国市场等因素的叠加，黑色星期五对我们的吸引力也越来越低。

即便如此，临近 2026 年的黑色星期五我们还是整理了一些海外平台上的促销活动，主要是国内没有官方销售渠道的一些商品和当下比较热门的单品。另外大家也可以比较下国内电商平台即将开始的双十二预热活动，综合考虑后再下手。

如今，微信小程序已成为亚马逊中国海外购的唯一官方渠道。对于想要购买没有国行版本的 Android 手机的用户来说，这仍是一个相当靠谱的渠道。平台还会提前计算进口税费，主打一个海外数码购物无烦恼。

虽说 2026 年数码产品及零部件普遍涨价，但如果你是非 Google Pixel 不买的 Android 死忠用户，那么选择亚马逊海外购准没错。以今年 Google 推出的 Pixel 11 系列为例，512 GB 版 Pixel 11 到手价可低至 5820.66 元，256 GB 版 Pixel 11 Pro 则可低至 6375.28 元。考虑到从 Pixel 11 系列开始，在国内网络环境下使用也不再需要太多折腾，还是相当值得推荐的。

同样，如果你是 Google Pixel 的死忠粉，且有能力搞定转运、报关等一系列操作，那么购买 Google 硬件的最佳渠道可能就是官方商城 Google Store。Google 今年也不免俗地在官方商城推出了黑五促销活动，并且相当「大气」地将今年发布的多款新品纳入促销范围。比如，新款 Pixel 11 Pro 和 Pixel 11 Pro XL 最高可省 400 美元，Pixel Watch 5 可省 100 美元，Pixel Buds Pro 则可省 60 美元。

除了最新款硬件，部分老款产品也在本次黑五促销活动之列。比如，Pixel 10 从原价 799 美元降至 599 美元（仅限 Indigo 和 Frost 配色）。可穿戴设备同样享有折扣，今年刚刚发布的无屏运动手环 Fitbit Air 套装从 149.99 美元降至 119.99 美元，Fitbit Inspire 3 则从 99.95 美元降至 69.95 美元。

如果你不太习惯佩戴智能手表，但又希望能够持续监测自己的睡眠及身体健康状况，那么智能戒指也是一个不错的选择。作为智能戒指领域的代表性品牌，Oura 今年也在自家官网推出了黑五促销活动，并将今年发布的 Oura Ring 5 纳入促销范围。

相比上一代产品，Oura Ring 5 延续了全钛金属设计，体积缩减约 40%，佩戴时的负担进一步减轻。今年黑五期间，Oura Ring 5 全系直降 100 美元，其中银色和黑色版本从原价 399 美元降至 299 美元，相当于原价的 7.5 折；金色、深玫瑰色、哑光黑色和拉丝银色版本则从原价 499 美元降至 399 美元。本次促销活动将持续至 11 月 30 日。

不过，需要注意的是，考虑到不同代际的 Oura Ring 在尺寸上也有所差异，建议先通过官方提供的尺寸测量套件确定适合自己的尺码后再入手。此外，Oura 的完整健康数据分析功能需要额外订阅 Oura Membership，美国地区的订阅价格为每月 5.99 美元或每年 69.99 美元，新用户可免费体验一个月。

亚马逊美国几乎每年都会在黑五期间推出各类优惠活动。对于我们这些海淘玩家来说，除了商品本身的折扣力度，最需要关注的就是商品是否支持直邮国内，以及相应的运费和税费。

items.content:
资深电视制片人鲍勃·格林布拉特 (Bob Greenblatt) 明白，为什么如今观看《干杯》或《广告狂人》等老剧比尝试观看新剧集更有吸引力。

在接受《纽约时报》采访时，格林布拉特承认，作为一部在流媒体中享受第二次生命的老热门节目的制片人比“向市场推出一个全新的节目”更容易。

“我们仍然受到每个流媒体服务上新节目的打击，与其试图弄清楚什么是值得投入的，不如逃到《宋飞正传》或《市中心修道院》更容易，因为你确切地知道自己会得到什么，”格林布拉特说，他目前是《镀金时代》的 EP。

格林布拉特的评论被收录在一个关于 Netflix 和 Amazon Prime 等平台上的老电视剧越来越受欢迎的故事中。 Luminate 报告称，与去年同期相比，今年第三季度主要流媒体服务中老游戏的收视率增长了 40% 以上。同一时期，新电视剧和电影的收视率有所下降。

Veteran TV producer Bob Greenblatt understands why streaming old shows like Cheers or Mad Men is a far more appealing alternative to viewers these days than trying to vibe with a new series.

In an interview with the New York Times, Greenblatt admitted that it’s easier to be a producer on an old hit that’s enjoying a second life in streaming than it is to launch “a whole new show to the marketplace.”

“We’re still being pummeled by new shows on every streaming service and rather than try to figure out what’s worth committing to, it’s easier to just escape into Seinfeld or Downtown Abbey because you know exactly what you’re getting,” said Greenblatt, who’s currently an EP on The Gilded Age.

Greenblatt’s comments were included in a story about the growing popularity of old TV hits on platforms like Netflix and Amazon Prime. Luminate reports that viewership of old titles during this year’s third quarter increased more than 40 percent among the major streaming services, compared with the same period last year. Tune in for new TV series and movies declined during that same time.

Dolly Parton will be honored with a special musical tribute at this year’s Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, which celebrates its historic 100th edition on Saturday after being postponed from Thanksgiving Day due to weather conditions.

Tony-nominated Broadway star Megan Hilty will lead the tribute to the country music icon, who died in August at age 80. The performance is among several high-profile musical numbers planned for the milestone celebration, alongside appearances from RAYE, Teddy Swims, Megan Moroney, Queen Latifah and “KPop Demon Hunters” breakout EJAE.

The 2026 Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade will air Saturday, Nov. 28, from 8:30 a.m. to noon in all time zones on NBC and Telemundo, with an encore presentation on NBC at 2 p.m. ET/PT. Those without cable can stream the festivities live on Peacock, in addition to a variety of live TV streaming services that carry NBC, including DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV and Sling TV in select markets.

“Today” show personalities Savannah Guthrie, Hoda Kotb and Al Roker will return to host the Emmy-winning telecast.

The parade’s 100th edition coincides with NBC’s own centennial anniversary, marking a particularly significant year for the network. More than 11,000 volunteers and participants will descend on Manhattan for Thursday’s festivities, which will span 2.5 miles from the Upper West Side to Macy’s flagship store in Herald Square. In a nod to the anniversary, Macy’s has assembled a record 100 inflatable creations, including new balloons depicting Bluey, Sorcerer’s Apprentice Mickey Mouse and Snoopy’s Joe Cool alter ego. The parade will also bring back balloons designed by some of the art world’s biggest names, including Tim Burton, Keith Haring, Jeff Koons and Yayoi Kusama.

Hollywood will be well represented among this year’s new floats, too, including a Hogwarts-themed creation from HBO. A commemorative Macy’s All Stars float will bring together familiar characters from throughout the parade’s history, from Bugs Bunny and Scooby-Doo to Sonic the Hedgehog.

Broadway, a fixture of the annual telecast, will get an expanded showcase this year. A 10-minute musical medley introduced by Julianne Hough will bring together performers from nine productions, including “Hamilton,” “Wicked,” “Rent,” “Chicago,” “The Book of Mormon,” “Aladdin,” “Schmigadoon!,” “The Lost Boys” and “The Rocky Horror Show.”

Other musical performers on this year’s roster include Natasha Bedingfield, Jimmy Fallon and the Roots, Keke Palmer, JoJo, Wyclef Jean, Leslie Odom Jr., Anthony Ramos, Indigo Girls, DEVO, Smash Mouth and K-pop boy band RIIZE. The Radio City Rockettes will also return before Santa Claus closes out the festivities.

Stream the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade live on Peacock, or watch for free with an eligible streaming trial through DirecTV.

《The Butcher’s Asylum》还将由全新配音演员担任旁白。新旁白仅出现在该模式中，不会影响此前推出的Confessions 和 Kingdoms模式。

items.content:
中新网杭州11月28日电(曹丹)11月27日，“案藏联韵——楹联档案文化展”在浙江省档案馆开展。展览以“档案里的楹联、楹联里的档案”为主轴，甄选70余幅楹联佳作，分为“两浙存联，一脉长延”“家国史怀，丹心永固”“新联焕彩，共富宏图”“档呈翰韵，明鉴春秋”四个篇章。

楹联是中华优秀传统文化的瑰宝，融文学意趣、书法艺术与民俗内涵于一体。档案则是历史记忆的真实载体，镌刻着文化传承和时代发展的深厚根基。

浙江省诗词与楹联学会会长王骏表示，双方联合举办楹联档案文化展等一系列活动，对激活档案文化资源的时代价值、推动楹联文化的普及传播起到了积极促进作用。

展厅里，一副左宗棠行书七言联前不时有观众驻足。“经济以诗书为鹄；文章得山海之华”，这副自勉联为左宗棠一生治学理念的写照，现藏于浙江省档案馆。其行书雄健豪迈，笔力刚劲，结体开张，气势沉雄。

一旁，梁启超的一副集字联“远载素书问黄石；自犁南雪种来禽”则集《张迁碑》字而成。其书法得《张迁碑》古拙雄浑之风，结体方整，笔致朴厚。

除左宗棠、梁启超外，展览还展出朱熹、伊秉绶、蔡元培、马一浮等历代名家与近代先贤的馆藏珍品。

欢迎来到「本月玩什么」，本栏目将从作者个人角度出发，独立挑选一些本月新发售的游戏作品/内容做简要介绍、评论，不保证收录覆盖面，且并非每一款都是笔者推荐游玩的，主要涵盖 PlayStation、Xbox、Nintendo、PC 和 iOS/Android 等主流平台；请注意，本文的探讨仅限于游戏刚发售时点的表现，游戏未来可能通过迭代变得更好或更差。期待这里能有勾起你兴趣的内容或探讨，也真诚感谢所有喜欢本栏目的朋友。

虹吸全游戏行业的巨无霸，带来迄今为止不一定最胡闹、但一定是最恢宏的模拟世界。

Take-Two 发行、Rockstar Games 出品，Grand Theft Auto V 首发十三年后终于到来，也是 Rockstar 联合创始人兼御用主笔 Dan Houser 2020 年离职之后，第一部没有他参与主导的《GTA》系列正作。

据 Take-Two 发布的数据，本作发售前预购量即达 3250 万套，发售当天全球零售额冲上 37.9 亿美元，刷新了单一娱乐产品的首发纪录。

《卫报》在其发售前体验感想中回顾了系列的创业历史：Rockstar North 的前身、成立于苏格兰邓迪的 DMA Design，1997 年推出了 GTA 初代，以俯视角描绘了虚构美国都市下的警匪追逐。据当年的主创回忆，项目每周都面临被海外发行方砍掉的风险，团队穷到连去美国实地采风的预算都没有、工作室只有一台电脑能上网，得靠大量摄入书、影、音等各式各样的媒体，来脑补出那个狂野的平行宇宙美国。此后近 30 年里，GTA 以纽约、迈阿密、洛杉矶、旧金山、拉斯维加斯等知名美国城市为蓝本，构建起愈发生动、拟真的犯罪故事舞台，直到今天我们终于能体验到系列的集大成者 GTA VI，这次供玩家大展拳脚的，是脱胎于佛罗里达州的“雷奥奈达”（Leonida），包括了 GTA IV 老玩家阔别多年的「罪恶都市」（Vice City）。

GTA VI 叙事上借鉴了经典电影《雌雄大盗》（Bonnie and Clyde），围绕有军人背景的男主 Jason Duval、刚假释出狱的女主 Lucia Caminos 展开。和有多位可操作主角的 GTA V 类似，本作也支持两位主角间的无缝切换（序幕中受限），玩家不控制的一方会自主按照作息行动，或者是响应玩家主控角色提出的交互，比如有事没事互发短信、一起健个身、拜托对方去销赃之类的。

GTA 系列的体验一直很强调拟真，玩家会身处于一座庞大且生动的城市（每一代 GTA 几乎都站在时代的前沿），一般来说，你可以顺着主线体验电影化、紧凑的故事——当然几乎都在犯事，也可以试着模拟某种生活，闲逛、消费、享受海陆空三栖游乐项目、完成啼笑皆非的支线委托、成为城市丛林里无法无天的兰博，尽管随心所欲。在营造庞大、精致、真实的世界这一点上，GTA VI 在全系列无疑登峰造极，且不单纯是前作的「超级加倍」，还吸收了《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》（Red Dead Redemption 2）在拟真方面的探索，比如：

与这些机制调整相伴的，是本作氛围的显著变化。玩家可能带着大开杀戒的预期而来，却发现自己栽进了一部「美国底层阶级：游戏版」装修爱巢、准备礼物、锻炼身体、跑腿催债、银行开户、对付逾期账单、被线上平台封号……Game Developer 称此为「日常琐事感」（Mundanity）在大作里的回潮，本想亡命天涯、却活出了一种蓝领阶层的柴米油盐味。笔者玩得非常慢，目前还在第一章到处探索，我一贯不着急在开放世界游戏里推主线，何况这是满大街都能杀出程咬金的 GTA。所以，对于游戏氛围变化的看法，我还需要更多深入游玩来沉淀。

我倒是想再聊聊发售前、刚上手这段时间，对《GTA VI》的更笼统印象。这部作品给了我很强的「矛盾感」，戏里戏外都是：

某种程度上，我也在以这种充满矛盾的心态接纳这部作品：我相信它会是我玩过的细节最缜密的游戏之一，探索的欲望驱使着我继续，与此同时，尽管可以理解，但主角的价值观中也有很多我不认同的地方。总之我就准备这么边想边玩下去。

法律、劳工与政治执行编辑

Netflix 的《狩猎妻子》在感恩节迎来了圣诞节，这要归功于愚蠢的小唐纳德·特朗普。

这位总统最年长、最雄心勃勃的儿子从不迟疑地把银脚放进他的大嘴里，在土耳其日早些时候，他因两个女人接吻的肥皂剧和流淌的 MAGA 主题系列的热情宣传而在数字项圈下变得非常热门。

11 月 26 日，在 X 节目上回复 Netflix 时，他宣称“你怎么了？？？今天是感恩节”，对争议和猜测并不陌生的小唐 (Don Jr.) 似乎为丽贝卡·卡特 (Rebecca Cutter) 创作的节目第二季推出带来了连泰德·萨兰多斯 (Ted Sarandos) 和格雷格·彼得斯 (Greg Peters) 资金雄厚的团队都买不到的宣传效果。

Executive Editor, Legal, Labor & Politics

Christmas came on Thanksgiving for Netflix‘s The Hunting Wives, thanks to a fatuous Donald Trump Jr.

Never slow to put his silver foot in his big mouth, the oldest and most ambitious son of El Presidente got very hot under the digital collar early on Turkey Day over a passionate promo for the soapy and streamy MAGA themed series of two women kissing.

In proclaiming “What is wrong with you??? It’s Thanksgiving” on X on November 26 in reply to Netflix, the no stranger to controversy and speculation Don Jr. looks to have handed the Season 2 launch of the Rebecca Cutter created show the kind of publicity even Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters‘ well-funded team can’t buy.

What is wrong with you??? It’s Thanksgiving.

While the First Louche’s outrage may have struck some as reeking of hypocrisy, or at least lacking all self-awareness, the fact is Don Jr’s tweet has been viewed over 7.5 million times since Thanksgiving morning. Add to that, a flood of media coverage from the highbrow to the gutter press and (we see you Fox News) everything in-between and you have yourself a good old fashion water cooler moment.

Starring Brittany Snow and Malin Åkerman as Sophie and Margo, a East Coastnewcomer to an East Texas town and the town’s leading lady, The Hunting Wives, which is based on the May Cobb novel of the same name. With guns, booze, short leather skirts, cowboy boots, MAGA, murder and lot of sex, the show follows Sophie as loses more and more of her old Boston life and more intimate with the scheming Margo, who’s Dermot Mulroney portrayed oil tycoon husband is running for Lone Star State Governor.

Hunting Wives scribe Brandon Zuck took out a shiv of his own against Don Jr. on Instagram, as well as delivering a backhanded compliment. “Just wait until season 3,” he wrote on his IG Story next to a screen shot of Junior’s tweet. That echoes what Cutter said when Netflix announced Season 3 last month. “Buckle up, because Season 3 will be even more scandalous and twisted,” the showrunner stated.

Further add to Jr’s ill-considered pearl clutching, the fact the actual online clip of Snow and Åkerman’s characters making out has itself claimed 36 million views on the (MAGA? Not MAGA?) Elon Musk-owned platform. All of which means the Streisand effect of Little Don’s post cannot have been helpful in pushing Hunting Wives Season 2’s eight episode debt to number #3 in the Netflix charts in less than 24 hours.

Likely not wanting to throw cold water on a good firestorm, Netflix did not respond to Deadline’s request for comment on Little Don’s tweet and the backlash it’s received. But, why would they? As WME Ari’s brother, former White House Chief of Staff and budding 2028 candidate Rahm Emanuel once said: “You never want a serious crisis to go to waste.”

In 2001, three films challenged familiar conventions of Hindi-language cinema in very different ways.

Farhan Akhtar‘s “Dil Chahta Hai” offered a new screen language for friendship and young adulthood; Ashutosh Gowariker‘s “Lagaan” turned a village cricket match into an epic about resistance; and Madhur Bhandarkar’s “Chandni Bar” took audiences into the largely unseen world of Mumbai’s dance bars. Twenty-five years later, the filmmakers revisited the films and the risks behind them at “The Legendary 25s,” a session at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa moderated by actor and producer Khushboo Sundar.

One thread connected their stories: all three had encountered the expectations of commercial Hindi cinema before finding the conviction to make something different.

Gowariker and Bhandarkar already had films behind them before “Lagaan” and “Chandni Bar” established their identities as filmmakers. Akhtar, making his directorial debut with “Dil Chahta Hai,” said he had not been interested in making a film that conformed to the prevailing Bollywood potboiler template.

For Gowariker, who is also the IFFI festival director this year, the turning point came after his first two films failed. Having initially tried to make commercial entertainers, he realized that “my next film had to be something I believe in, something that I want to make first, and then hope to God that the audience also likes it. So that’s how the genesis of ‘Lagaan’ happened.”

The idea was an unlikely proposition: a period drama built around a cricket match, with villagers taking on the British. Gowariker wanted to make a film about “a group of heroes.” He researched the British Raj, 19th-century life, cricket and village communities before taking the script back to star Aamir Khan, who had initially rejected the premise. Gowariker asked Khan for just three hours to hear the narration of “Lagaan” before deciding. “He heard it. He laughed, he had tears and he said, ‘I definitely want to do this now,'” Gowariker recalled of the film, which went on to receive an Oscar nomination.

Bhandarkar’s route to “Chandni Bar” was rooted in observation. A visit to a dance bar with a friend gave him the subject for the Tabu-starring film, which he researched by visiting bars across Mumbai for six months. “Even if, in retrospect, ‘Chandni Bar’ had not done well at the box office, I would still be happy because this is the cinema which I wanted to make, and this is the world which I’ve seen,” he said.

His interest in underdogs has continued in films such as “Page 3,” “Corporate” and “Fashion,” which examined the worlds of the media, business and fashion respectively. He has also resisted pressure to turn women-centered stories into male-led films for commercial reasons. From Tabu’s vulnerable character in “Chandni Bar” to Raveena Tandon’s politically ambitious woman in “Satta,” he said he is drawn to complex women rather than idealized portrayals. “My movies are basically a mirror to society,” he said.

With “Dil Chahta Hai,” a buddy movie starring Aamir Khan, Saif Ali Khan and Akshaye Khanna, Akhtar set out to bring a more recognizable version of friendship to the screen. He felt Hindi films’ depictions of male friendship did not reflect how people actually spent time together. “The relationship had become cheesy, filmy,” he said. He cited Mansoor Khan’s “Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak” (1988), which he watched as a schoolboy, as an important influence.

Asked specifically about the older-woman romance in “Dil Chahta Hai,” he said the inspiration for the relationship between the characters played by Akshaye Khanna and Dimple Kapadia came “from many crushes that I had on older women, that’s the honest truth.”

Thursday was a dual celebration for Justin Timberlake‘s visit with Jimmy Fallon on NBC’s Tonight Show: There was Thanksgiving, of course, which you can see in the photo above was most certainly not ignored by the two old friends, and then for the former boy bander the visit was an opportunity to celebrate the 20th anniversary of his album FutureSex/LoveSounds.

And of course there’s always new material to plug, and last night it was Timberlake‘s four-part doc series streaming on Apple TV beginning December 11.

The Thanksgiving visit began with Timberlake joining Fallon in a musical number celebrating “The History of Party Songs.” With Timberlake initially putting up some mock reluctance, the two then launched into Soul II Soul’s “Back to Life (However Do You Want Me),” then proceeded through a smorgasbord of classic dance hits, including Ini Kamoze’s “Here Comes the Hotstepper,” Mark Morrison’s “Return of the Mack,” Montell Jordan’s “This Is How We Do It,” Spice Girls “Wannabe,” Bell Biv DeVoe’s “Poison,” Timberlake’s own “Rock Your Body,” Wild Cherry’s “Play That Funky Music White Boy,” “Good Times” by Chic, Cool and the Gang’s “Celebration,” and some others you might be able catch before the big finish of The Backstreet Boys’ “I Want It That Way.”

Timberlake also reflected on the making of the FutureSex/LoveSounds album, noting that at the time of its recording he’d been listening to “Bowie, David Byrne, Talking Heads, Freddie Mercury, Queen, Billy Idol, James Brown, Eurythmics, INXS…but we were kind of thinking, How we can take the sonics of dance music and flip it?”

Timberlake recalls that, as presented in the upcoming docuseries, his record label at the time was not initially impressed with the album, thinking it was “too fast,” to which Timberlake responded, “That’s why it’s going to work.” He also remembered that the label was disappointed that he wasn’t using his signature falsetto enough. “I was listening to [David Bowie’s] ‘Rebel Rebel’ a lot…and that music at that time sounded so daring.” Timberlake says he wanted to create the impression that the singer was a character in the song, as Bowie so often did, and the result was “SexyBack.”

Regarding the upcoming four-part Timberlake documentary series, the singer explained that he overcame his initial reluctance – “I’m sort of famously private” – by trusting director and friend Fisher Stevens. “I feel like I’ve gone through a lot in the last five years that made me a better human,” he said.

“But the more we sat down and talked, the more I found myself searching for something that was beneath the surface a little more,” he continued. “And I think that at the end of the day I sort of mustered up some courage to talk about things that I’ve never talked about before. Things that even those that are closest to me don’t know.”

Timberlake also paid tribute to the late singer-songwriter D’Angelo, the major influence who died October 14, 2025. “D’Angelo, for me, he changed everything,” Timberlake told Fallon. “You know, he was one of those artists. Rest in peace. What a brilliant, brilliant, brilliant artist. But I remember when he came out, it just like everything changed. [He] was a once-in-a-generation artist.”

And finally, here’s Timberlake’s performance that capped the Fallon appearance, taking place at New York’s famed Rainbow Room atop 30 Rock. He performs a medley of “FutureSex/LoveSound,” “SexyBack,” “Summer Love” and “My Love.”
